description: This file manages plugin runtime dependencies for a Node.js project, including reading/writing JSON files, handling dependencies' installation and staging, and managing plugin directories and their dependencies, specifically in the context of OpenClaw plugins.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the specified path.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Writes a JSON value to a specified file path with formatting.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a directory or file at the given path if it exists.

methods.name: makeTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a specific prefix.

methods.name: sanitizeTempPrefixSegment
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used safely as a temp directory prefix.

methods.name: replaceDir
methods.description: Replaces a directory by moving or copying source to target, with fallback.

methods.name: dependencyNodeModulesPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a dependency's node_module directory.

methods.name: readInstalledDependencyVersion
methods.description: Reads the installed version of a dependency from node_modules.

methods.name: dependencyVersionSatisfied
methods.description: Checks if an installed dependency version satisfies a semver requirement.

methods.name: collectInstalledRuntimeClosure
methods.description: Collects all runtime dependencies recursively satisfying version constraints.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDirs
methods.description: Lists all plugin directories under the dist/extensions folder.

methods.name: hasRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Determines if a package.json declares runtime dependencies.

methods.name: shouldStageRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if runtime dependencies should be staged based on plugin configuration.

methods.name: sanitizeBundledManifestForRuntimeInstall
methods.description: Removes specific openclaw peer, dev, dependencies from a plugin's package.json before installation.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeDepsStampPath
methods.description: Gets the path to the runtime deps stamp file in a plugin directory.

methods.name: createRuntimeDepsFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a sha256 hash fingerprint of the package.json for caching.

methods.name: readRuntimeDepsStamp
methods.description: Reads the runtime deps stamp file if present.

methods.name: stageInstalledRootRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Stages (copies and links) all runtime dependencies for the root project into plugin directory.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Installs runtime dependencies for a plugin, performing npm install in a temp directory.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDepsWithRetries
methods.description: Retries installation of runtime dependencies up to a specified number of attempts.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Main exported function that stages runtime dependencies for all bundled plugins in the project.
